claims.content: Diverges from Step 1: If specific filters have been prearranged, C2 JU may select only the filter number for the J7.6 (ACT = 0) implementation request, setting all Filter Indicator fields to value 0.

At main-flow step 1, if C2 JU's filter-content selection would use the message label/sublabel filter to avoid the data forwarding requirements set forth in Appendix C, Data Forwarding, that use is prohibited.
At main-flow step 2, if a J7.6 (ACT = 2) message is received, remote filters shall be dropped.
At main-flow step 2, when C2 JU deletes a filter that it had reported, it should transmit a J7.6 (ACT = 2) message.
At main-flow step 4, if Force Tell or Emergency Indicators are set in J3 messages, those messages override all operator-controllable data filters.
At main-flow step 4, if the storage files of the JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of new data shall not be required, regardless of the data's ID or priority.

claims.content: Coordinate the use of interface filters with all IUs to minimize track management problems.
Data filter implementation is optional and system constraints may dictate the type of filters used.
When PPLI data becomes available from J2 messages, C2 JU is triggered to reduce the redundancy of surveillance track reporting.

C2 JU selects the content for the J7.6 (ACT = 0) Filter Implementation Request: for a new filter, it specifies the filter types and parameters for each type, whether to filter inside or outside the defined area, and sets the Filter Number field to value 0; for prearranged filters, it specifies the filter number with all Filter Indicator fields set to value 0.
C2 JU uses the J7.6 (ACT = 0) Filter Implementation Request message to request that the filter be implemented by another JU.
C2 JU conducts voice coordination in addition to the filter message to ensure filter management on the interface.
C2 JU coordinates the use of interface filters with all IUs to minimize track management problems.
Diverges from Step 1: If specific filters have been prearranged, C2 JU may select only the filter number for the J7.6 (ACT = 0) implementation request, setting all Filter Indicator fields to value 0.

At main-flow step 1, if C2 JU's filter-content selection would use the message label/sublabel filter to avoid the data forwarding requirements set forth in Appendix C, Data Forwarding, that use is prohibited.
At main-flow step 2, if a J7.6 (ACT = 2) message is received, remote filters shall be dropped.
At main-flow step 2, when C2 JU deletes a filter that it had reported, it should transmit a J7.6 (ACT = 2) message.
At main-flow step 4, if Force Tell or Emergency Indicators are set in J3 messages, those messages override all operator-controllable data filters.
At main-flow step 4, if the storage files of the JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of new data shall not be required, regardless of the data's ID or priority.
The requested transmit interface filters have been implemented as requested via J7.6 (ACT = 0).
Voice coordination, where used, has been completed to ensure interface filter management.
Interface filter use has been coordinated with all IUs, minimizing track management problems.
